text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The one who conquered the Spring and 
Autumn Short-Distance GⅠs is none other 
than this Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the first-class Umamusume with the 
most magnificent run! It is I, King 
Halo—!!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, well, it's only a natural result♪

text_block_list.name: Veteran Cameraman
text_block_list.text: King-saaan! Look over here, pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Ah, over here too! Over here too! Give me 
your best smiles, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Very well! I shall grant you the 
privilege of capturing the finest 
photograph of your entire lives!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, members of the press. You certainly 
work fast.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"King Halo: The New Heroine of Sprint" 
"Spring & Autumn Double Victory Next 
Year!?" ...it says.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Fufu, but—
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, why does it have to ring at a time 
like this?! Who is it now—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They really have the worst timing. 
Excuse me for a moment, I'll take this 
call.
(Beep...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...To think she'd actually produce 
results."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It went just as I anticipated. Was it 
different for you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...And then what? Are you heading for the 
Mile Championship next? Sticking to the 
sprint and mile route...?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I won't stick to such a predetermined 
path. I have no intention of ending things 
just as the Queen of Sprinting.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am King Halo. An Umamusume with 
limitless talent."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Next, I shall take to a new stage and 
show the world my talent—at the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...Foolish girl."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Who are you talking about? Well, I 
don't have time for this, so I'm hanging 
up.

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...I see. In that case—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text: "—Just try and win, if you can."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...If I'm a foolish daughter, then she's 
a foolish mother, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Why debut at a time like this? She's 
bound to get crushed in a generation full 
of powerhouse runners."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...Come back home before you embarrass 
yourself."

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I suggest you come home before you 
embarrass yourself any further."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Telling me to 'try and win' at this point, 
of all times.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I know that without you having to tell 
me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us go, Trainer. The road to glory 
that I walk still stretches far ahead.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, next is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). I 
simply must hear that thunderous roar from 
the crowd.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The roaring cheers of the crowd going wild 
for King's victory, that is!
